status: incomplete_event_log; aggregate outcome is sufficient to reject minute-SLA success
scope: Real AMap; physical unplug/screen-off; isolated order/local upload counter; no care backend writes

window.boundaryUncertainty: Start extrapolated from host/USB mapping; observation and command latency are unquantified. Reconnection events excluded.

evidence: Before-unplug durable count is uploads4/client1; after-unplug is uploads7/client2.
Retained probe.log jumps from first upload/client1 to later query/client2, omitting uploads2..7, CPU-lock acquisition and client2 creation.
Retained health lifetime count cb7/ok7 contradicts interpreting zero retained SDK/HTTP events in the window as zero actual events.

localUploadSuccessBounds.jointBound: sum of all five bucket counts is between1 and3; per-bucket upper bounds are not jointly additive
localUploadSuccessBounds.lastBucketZeroBasis: No durable upload counter update follows lastUpload within the later after-unplug observation; lastUpload precedes the fifth bucket.
localUploadSuccessBounds.timestampLimitation: lastUpload is written by the local repository immediately before returning success, not an exact retained http_end timestamp; exact HTTP completion distribution cannot be recovered.

retainedEventsOnly.interpretation: Counts describe retained records only, not actual runtime counts; exact raw callback/source-tick/bucket counts and callback/query maximum gaps are unknown.

mainLoop.healthTimestampLimitation: JSON lacks absolute elapsed timestamp; the health record is bracketed by a query near the window end and one just after it.
mainLoop.interpretation: The15.139s maximum health tick gap is evidence of continued scheduled processing over that reporting period. Missing intermediate query lines do not establish main-loop suspension or UID freezing.

cpuSuspendBounds.clockReadCaveat: Adjacent elapsed/uptime reads are millisecond observations, not atomic hardware capture. Recorded bounds are zero at this resolution; do not claim sub-millisecond certainty.

wakeLockEvidence.interpretation: App-requested PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK is present in power snapshots and history, and elapsed−uptime is unchanged across a bracket containing the whole window.

batteryHistory.causalLimit: CPU stayed running while light Doze was still observed. This does not by itself identify which AMap request or network policy caused the remaining gaps.

assessment.reason: At most3 additional local successes between snapshots that contain the full300s window cannot cover5 complete one-minute buckets.
assessment.reasonAgainstDirectProductionLock: The experimental CPU lock eliminated observable CPU sleep but did not achieve the minute upload goal; retained logs are incomplete, and neither SDK-only silence nor UID freezing is established.
assessment.nextEvidence: Recover/bound the missing log segment or use an app-private bounded test trace in the next controlled experiment. Keep CPU, SDK, admission and upload counts separate.
